description: Evaluating the impacts of the Dar es Salaam Bus Rapid Transit System is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Harvard Dataverse. Stata do files and ready-for-analysis data used in the analysis published in the Final Report to 3ie for the project, "Evaluating the impacts of the Dar es Salaam Bus Rapid Transit System" (project code DPW1.1029). This project was funded as part of the Development Priority window. Coverage: Tanzania. The portal files it under the publisher Harvard Dataverse. Its tags are Social Sciences. The repository dates the deposit 2020; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom terms specific to this dataset. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
